title: What Lee gave to music: inspiration and youth
summary: Lee gave inspiration and happiness, advised young musicians, and believed music keeps youngsters out of mischief.

story.theme_name: Teaching jazz: schools, students and advice to the young
story.community_name: Advice to young musicians starting out

blocks.x: Yeah, that big funeral. Did, what, what, to sort of sum this up, what, what do you think Lee gave to the music, to the music that he played?

Inspiration. Inspiration. That's what I feel. Inspiration. Happiness. He was always happy, smiling, had a big smile on his face. Young musicians, he would try to tell them right from wrong and what a hard life it was. But if you were a musician and you wanted to play.

It was there and you tried and go ahead and do it. And it could be. And he think that music keep youngsters out of mischief. Really. He did? He always said music would. I mean, if they wanted to do it.

They didn't have to have the inspiration to do it. But he felt that that's the best medicine for youngsters is music. And he was a kid. And he could have been into trouble too. But he didn't. So that's how he felt about it.
